content: Kememɨte'utahɨawarie 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata memexeiyanikɨ
Neuxei Teukiru, matɨari paitɨ xapa neputawewi naitɨ kemɨtiuyɨ hepaɨtsita tikuxatame, Ketsutsi kemɨtitsutɨa yatiyurienetɨ meta ti'ɨkitatɨ,
mɨpaɨ tiuyurieka 'ana kananutiwitɨkieni, 'aitsika warupitɨaka nɨ'ariekate mɨwaranayexei, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata yati'aitakaku.
Hikɨta tiukwineka mɨkɨ, wahetsɨa 'uyeikatɨ puyuhekɨatakai kemɨrayenierekai mamariwawemekɨ tiyurienetɨ. Huta tewiyari tukari mepixeiyakai. Tiwakuxaxatɨwame kemɨreuyewetse Kakaɨyari ti'aitametɨkaku.
Hikɨ wahamatɨa tikwatɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'aitɨani: —Kerutsaremetsie xepɨka'ayekɨkani, matsi xekeneta'ikwewani tita ne'ukiyari mɨtixatakai kename tixehanɨ'airieni, ketita xemɨte'u'eni netikuxatakaku:
Wani hakɨ xeikɨa katini'ɨyanekaitɨni, xeme matsi 'Iyari Mɨtiyupatakɨ xepɨka'ɨyarieni yapaɨmexɨa tukari 'anukayayu.
Hɨkɨ mɨkɨ hamatɨana memuyukuxeɨri mɨpaɨ mekateniku'iwawiyakaitɨni: —Ti'aitame, ¿hikɨri petihekwatɨani 'Ixaheri mɨra'aitakaitsie?
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xeme xehetsie pɨkatinake xemɨtemaikakɨ kepauka tukari mɨtinake. Ne'ukiyari xeikɨa yakatini'aitani.

Matsi xekanitɨrɨkariyariekuni 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata yuhetsie xehexeiyatɨ. Xemunenierixɨ xepɨhɨkɨtɨni xetehekɨatatɨ nehepaɨtsita Kerutsareme, naitsarie Kureyatsie, Tsamariyatsie meta naitsarie kwie manuniere paitɨ.
Mɨpaɨ tikuxatakaku, mɨkɨ me'ixeiyakaku, kananutiwitɨkieni, hai kaniukuyani memɨka'ixeiyakɨ.
Hikɨ yuheima mehautinenierekaku mexi 'a'utimiekai, yapauka 'ukitsi yuhutatɨ wa'aurie mekaniti'uni mehautuxatɨ.

Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniwarutahɨawe: —Karereyutari, ¿titayari mana xeteti'u muyuawitsie xeheutinenieretɨ? Mɨkɨ Ketsutsi xetsata 'uwetɨ manutiwitɨkie, kexemɨte'ixei muyuawitsie heutimieme, yaxeikɨata tiyuxexeiyatɨ kaninuamɨkɨ.
Matiyaxi kemɨranayexeiyarie Kura hetsiemieme
Hikɨ Kerutsareme mekaniu'axɨani yemuri Huriwu mati'u mɨrakutewatsie meheyekɨneka, 'uxipiya tukaritsie tewi kemɨtipitɨarie mana muyeikanikɨ, xeikirumeturuyari petewakai Kerutsareme.

Hikɨ me'u'axɨaka, kiita mekaneutihaxɨani wapaitɨ memayukuxexeɨriwatsie. Muwa mepayetekai Pekuru, Kakuwu, Wani, 'Atɨrexi, Peripe, Tumaxi, Waxiturume, Mateu, Kakuwu 'Aripeu nu'aya, Tsimuni Tseruti kiekame meta Kura Kakuwu nu'aya.
Mɨkɨ yunaitɨ xei'iyariyari mepexeiyakai, meyuxewitɨ nenewierikɨ mepɨ'ayumiemetetɨkai, 'ukarawetsixi yunaitɨ, Mariya Ketsutsi maamaya meta 'iwamama.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ tukaritsie Pekuru yu'iwama wahixɨapa kaniutakeni, teɨteri memuyuxeɨriekai xeitsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari mekaniyupaɨmekaitɨni,

mɨpaɨ Pekuru katiniwarutahɨawe: «Ne'iwama, kaneuyewekaitɨni 'utɨarika maye'anikɨ, meripaitɨ kemutayɨ 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata, Rawiri mɨpaɨ 'utayɨku Kura hepaɨtsita, mɨkɨ kemɨ'ane mɨwarewitɨ Ketsutsi mɨwiyarienikɨ.
Kura tahamatɨa puyeikakai, meta tahamatɨa pɨti'uximayakai.
(Hikɨ tumini mu'ɨitɨariekɨ kwie kaniunaneni, mana 'atiweka yumu'ukɨ kaniukaweni kaniutatsane, kwinurieya naitɨ kanawiwieni.
Kerutsareme memɨtama yunaitɨ mepɨte'utamari, 'ayumieme mana kwiepa 'Atserirama katinakutewaka waniukikɨ, manɨyɨne “Xuriya Mataxɨri” katinakutewaka).
»Karikɨ Nɨawari xapayari puta'utɨarie mɨpaɨ 'anuyɨtɨ:
Metatsiere mɨpaɨ pɨre'uxa:
'Ayumieme, kaneuyeweka xeime temanayexeiya munierixɨ tahamatɨa memu'uwakai tukarikɨ kepauka Ti'aitame Ketsutsi tahetsɨa muyeikakaitsie,
mɨkɨ tukaritsie Wani meka'ɨyaxɨtsie, meta kepauka tatsata manutiwitɨkietsie, peuyewetse mɨkɨ xewitɨ memunenierixɨ tahamatɨa tihekɨatatɨ mayanikɨ kemɨranukuke».
Hikɨ yuhutame mekaniwaranayexeiya Kutse Waritsawaxi mɨtitewakai meta Kutsitu mɨtimatiwakai, metatsiere Matiyaxi panayexeiyarie.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniyutanenewieni: «'Ekɨ Ti'aitame yunaime wa'iyari pemɨmate. Ketaneuxeitsitɨa kemɨ'ane pemanuyexeiya 'ikɨ yuhutame wahetsie,
hetsiena mɨtinakenikɨ 'ikɨ hepaɨtsita mɨhɨritɨarienikɨ mɨtanɨ'arienikɨ, Kura mɨtiuhayewaxɨkɨ yu'ɨtɨma metɨakɨ».
'Inɨari mepuwewi kemɨ'ane rahetsie mɨtinakekekai. Matiyaxi hetsie katiniunake. Mɨkɨ nɨ'ariekate wahamatɨa matiwatɨ patɨa tamamata heimana xewi.
